mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary_command (id, command_id, member_id, operation, itinerary_id, expected_version, request_hash, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{commandId}, #{memberId}, #{operation}, #{itineraryId}, #{expectedVersion}, #{requestHash}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT command_id, member_id, operation, request_hash, result_itinerary_id, result_item_id, result_version FROM itinerary_command WHERE command_id = #{commandId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary (id, owner_member_id, title, start_date, end_date, time_zone, base_currency, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{title}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{timeZone}, #{baseCurrency}, #{status}, #{version}, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO itinerary_destination (id, itinerary_id, name, country_code, time_zone, position, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{itineraryId}, #{name}, #{countryCode}, #{timeZone}, #{position}, #{now}, #{now})
INSERT INTO itinerary_day (id, itinerary_id, day_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{itineraryId}, #{date}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_member_id, title, start_date, end_date, time_zone, base_currency, status, version FROM itinerary WHERE id = #{itineraryId}
SELECT id, name, country_code, time_zone, position FROM itinerary_destination WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} ORDER BY position, id
SELECT id, day_date FROM itinerary_day WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} ORDER BY day_date, id

SELECT id, itinerary_day_id, title, place_name, start_time, end_time, notes, estimated_cost, position, deleted_at FROM itinerary_item WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY itinerary_day_id, position, id
